items.title: Opaque cookie session authentication
items.proves: Requests must present sti_session; identity is loaded from hashed browser_sessions, not a JWT payload.

items.title: Session cookie flags and HMAC storage
items.proves: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production; 32-byte tokens hashed with SESSION_HASH_KEY; 8h absolute; idle 30/120 min.

items.title: Production Bearer JWT disabled
items.proves: issueSessionToken throws in production.

items.title: CSRF double-submit
items.proves: Non-GET mutations require matching sti_csrf cookie, X-CSRF-Token header, and csrf_hash.

items.title: RBAC permission catalog
items.proves: Four portal roles; STUDENT has PRIVATE_MESSAGES_VIEW only; no ADMIN role.

items.title: requireExactRoles account gates
items.proves: Student onboarding and admin profile are role-gated at the router.

items.title: SYSTEM_ADMIN is not a portal home
items.proves: getHomePath('SYSTEM_ADMIN') is /unauthorized (frontend/tests/routes.test.js).

items.title: bcrypt cost 12
items.proves: Passwords hashed with bcrypt cost 12.

items.title: OTP limits and hashing
items.proves: 6-digit OTP, 10 min TTL, 5 attempts, 60s resend, HMAC stored, prior codes superseded.

items.title: Application rate limits
items.proves: In-memory limits: 200/15m IP, 600/15m verified account GET, auth 10/15m, certificate verify 30/15m. Render service STI-Vio-Log numInstances is 1 on the free plan, so those counters cover every request that service handles. A second instance would not share them.

items.title: Vercel CSP, HSTS, preview isolation
items.proves: HTTPS CSP, frame deny, production API proxy required, preview must not equal production API origin.

items.title: Production config fail-closed
items.proves: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS, independent secrets, HTTPS FRONTEND_URL, DB_SSL required in production.

items.title: RLS enabled in migrations
items.proves: 2026-11-13 production query: 51/51 public tables have RLS. RLS is not forced. postgres owns the tables and can bypass RLS. The live pooler sessions use sti_vio_log_app, which is not superuser and does not have CREATEDB, CREATEROLE, or BYPASSRLS. Render startup logged Production readiness passed with 54 migrations, which also requires that runtime login.

items.title: QR uses server clock
items.proves: Attendance time uses SELECT clock_timestamp().

items.title: CI security workflow
items.proves: Run 43382919619 on defense-verification: secret-scan, verify, security-sbom, database-security, and CodeQL static analysis all completed successfully. Gitleaks is no longer behind the npm audit step.

items.title: C-01/C-02 remediations
items.proves: Route-level BFLA hardening and LAN IP log removal; 37/37 targeted tests PASS on 2026-11-10.

items.title: Production migration count
items.proves: Production schema_migrations contains 001 through 054. No migration was applied on 2026-11-13 because none were pending.

items.title: Backup restore drill
items.proves: 2026-11-13 07:09 UTC encrypted archive sti-vio-log-2026-11-13T07-09-07-867Z.dump.enc (1335980 bytes) was decrypted and restored with pg_restore into disposable local database sti_vio_log_restore on 127.0.0.1:55432. Restored schema_migrations count was 54, latest 054_message_inbox_preferences.sql. Restored students 19, users 23, and violations 30, matching production counts at the same time. Supabase pg_cron and supabase_vault objects did not load on local PostgreSQL. The Windows WIN1252 cluster also skipped conversation_messages; production still had 24 message rows. The disposable database was dropped and the plaintext dump deleted. The encryption key remains only in C:/Users/Ezian/sti-vio-log-private/backup.key. Provider PITR retention was not visible from the database connection.

items.title: Platform DDoS and Data API
items.proves: stiviolog.com responds Server Vercel with HSTS. sti-vio-log.onrender.com responds Server cloudflare and x-render-origin-server Render; that is Render's edge, not a school Cloudflare WAF. No Cloudflare zone is configured for the school domain. Supabase Data API https://plqbfcygzqrdagxwbgnt.supabase.co/rest/v1/ returns 401 without a key. anon and authenticated have no table or routine grants. They still have USAGE on schema public. The dashboard Data API switch was not confirmed off.

items.title: Public pages and certificate verify
items.proves: 2026-11-13 live GET /api/certificates/clearance/CLR-1-not-a-valid-code returned 404 Certificate is invalid with no student fields. Unauthenticated GET /api/students/me returned 401. Public routes /, /login, /forgot-password, /reset-password/verify, /privacy, and /terms rendered no student records, session tokens, or onboarding email. /privacy shows the published dpo@sti.edu contact. Signed-in OTP, MFA, ownership, department, QR, and realtime checks were not run because no production test account was available. Browser storage no longer persists onboarding_google_email or service-attendance-qr.
